items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: Captain Brown that I know played the violin

ctx.x: Well, to interrupt you again, would the Stratford Spiders musicians or anything? Oh yes, yes.

Now they were, like Captain Brown that I know played the violin, and some of them, like Captain Joe, I learned to play the piano. And they really knew me. They knew how, I tell you what I would know is they were good at, you see, making your program on that boat. Your music had to be timed to get a certain many numbers within the program. The program ran from about four, and they always had what they call side numbers, you see, and you always had to have numbers, you had to time yourself, a certain program, and…
Oh, we left out in Memphis in town.
